final saved = <int>[];
final paths = <String>[];
Future<void> save(int item) async { saved.add(item); }
Future<void> main() async {
  final items = [1, 2, 3];
  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    final message = '''That's an item.
Please save it.''';
    await save(items[i]);
    paths.add(message);
  }
  if (saved.join(',') != '1,2,3') throw StateError('$saved');
  print('saved=$saved');
}
